meta.name: itr-wala
meta.description: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax, advance tax, or the income-tax e-filing portal - even if they just say "help me with my taxes" in an Indian context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 申报印度个人所得税并核对退税
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在印度有应税收入需要自行申报个税或核对退税。
copy.tagline_en: File Indian income tax returns and check your refund
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have taxable income in India and need to file your own tax return or reconcile a refund.

howto.what: Claude 会陪你准备印度个人所得税申报（FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27）：读取 Form 16、AIS 等文件，由本地 Python 脚本计算税额并对比新旧税制，最后生成申报包；缴款、提交、e-Verify 由你本人完成。
howto.when: 当你说要报印度个税、比较新旧税制，或要读 Form 16、AIS、26AS 等文件时触发；问起 ITR 表格、80C/80D 等条款或加密币税也适用。仅限 AY 2026-27 的居民个人。

say.text: 帮我报一下 2025-26 年度的个税
say.note: 它会先确认身份与收入来源，再让你把文件放进工作区。

say.text: 比较一下旧税制和新税制，哪个退税多？
say.note: 会运行本地脚本给出对比表与差额。

say.text: 帮我核对 Form 16 和 AIS 里的 TDS 对不对
say.note: 逐项转录并做交叉校验。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you prepare your Indian ITR (FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27): it reads Form 16, AIS and similar docs, runs local Python scripts to compute tax and compare regimes, and builds a filing pack. You pay, submit and e-verify yourself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to file an Indian ITR, compare the old vs new regime, or read Form 16, AIS or 26AS, and for questions on ITR forms, sections or crypto tax. Resident individuals, AY 2026-27 only.

say_en.text: Help me file my income tax return for FY 2025-26
say_en.note: Confirms residency and income sources, then asks for docs.

say_en.text: Compare the old and new tax regime for me
say_en.note: Runs the local script and shows a comparison table.

say_en.text: Check my Form 16 and AIS TDS against 26AS
say_en.note: Transcribes each figure and cross-checks totals.
